# gravitino_idp_group Resource

Manages a built-in IDP group for local authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Built-in IDP group with members
resource "gravitino_idp_group" "engineers" {
  name    = "engineers"
  comment = "Platform engineering"
  users   = ["alice", "bob"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group name.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional description of the group.
- `users` (Set of String) The usernames of members in the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name of the built-in IDP group.
